newsitem.title: USA: Alabama helicopter crash kills three Army soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Alabama helicopter crash kills three Army soldiers.

text.p: An instructor and two student pilots were killed when their Army helicopter crashed in southeast Alabama, Army officials said on Saturday.
The three crew members were doing night flight training in a UH-1E Iroquois helicopter when it crashed on Friday night, said a spokesman from Fort Rucker base.

Soldiers and firefighters from the Army Aviation Centre at Fort Rucker and Geneva County Sheriff's deputies began searching for the helicopter after the crew failed to give a scheduled position report.
A search party on the ground found the downed helicopter in a field Saturday morning about 2-1/2 miles east of Samson, Ala. The crash site is about 20 miles southwest of Fort Rucker.
The crew members were pronounced dead at the scene. Their names were being withheld until family members had been notified.
The U.S. Army The U.S. Army said its safety centre is investigating the cause of the accident.
